 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Dr. Anshuman

Oral Order
2 22-03-2023
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

The present Cr. Writ Petition has been filed seeking direction to the respondent to arrest the accused of Masaurhi P.S. Case No. 385 of 2020 lodged under Sections 366, 366(A) of the Indian Penal Code and also to add more sections under Section 12 of POCSO Act as well as Section 376 of I.P.C. in the F.I.R.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that both Patna High Court CR. WJC No.846 of 2021(2)
dt.22-03-2023 accused and victim have been arrested by the Police but instead of production before the Court of law, the Police in connivance with the accused had released him, in result, the said accused has never been produced before the Court and still Court is awaiting his presence for trial.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the State submits that for the purpose of adding the section, the petitioner has the right to move before the cognizance taking Court and for the production of accused in the trial,
there are established procedure of law in the Cr.P.C.
So far as the alleged wrongful act done by the high officials, the representation of petitioner was pending before them.

He further submits that petitioner may be directed to move before the high officials in the light of Surendra Singh Vs. State of Bihar and others vide order dated 09.09.2022 passed in Cr.W.J.C. No. 153 of 2017 with analogous cases.

entities.text: Surendra Singh Vs. State of Bihar and others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In this background, it transpires to this Court that the petitioner shall move before the Senior Superintendent of Police, Patna in the light of Surendra Singh Vs. State of Bihar and others vide order dated 09.09.2022 passed in Cr.W.J.C. No. 153 of 2017 with analogous cases and file his representation within four weeks.

entities.text: Surendra Singh Vs. State of Bihar and others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
So far as addition of more sections are concerned, Patna High Court CR. WJC No.846 of 2021(2)
dt.22-03-2023 petitioner is at liberty to move before the appropriate forum at appropriate stage.
With this direction, the present Cr. Writ Petition stands disposed off.

(Dr. Anshuman, J.) ritik/-
